_comment: Master JSON config for blue_engine. Edit the 'strategies' block to enable/disable each strategy. Each enabled strategy must have its own config block at the top level (with the same name).
_comment_auth: Leave api_key/host/ws_url null to use environment variables OPENALGO_API_KEY, HOST_SERVER, WEBSOCKET_URL (recommended).
_comment_risk: [RISK GATE] Pre-trade caps enforced by core/risk_gate.py before any child order. Absence of a key = that cap is NOT enforced, so every monetary cap below is set explicitly. max_daily_loss / max_open_exposure come from the LIVE broker positionbook (core/risk_context.py) unless overridden here. require_live_ack=true REJECTS a live run when no monetary cap is configured (an unverified risk profile is not 'permission to trade'). Keep blocked=true until you intend to trade.
_comment_exit_engine: [EXIT ENGINE] Broker-side protection for filled positions (core/exit_engine.py). After the slicer finishes, a working SL-M is placed for every open position, verified against the orderbook, and reconciled every check_interval_seconds for supervise_seconds. stop level = the protective registry's level, else default_stop_pct of the broker price. Market flattening (allow_market_exit) and flattening unregistered positions (flatten_unprotected) are OFF by default on purpose. Remove this block and a filled position is UNPROTECTED.
_comment_keylevel: Keylevel signal. Only used when 'keylevel' is true above. Polls LTP and fires the trade when the trigger is crossed.
_comment_ocl_keylevel: OCL Keylevel signal. Only used when 'ocl_keylevel' is true above. Scans HTF for Red-Red-Green (or Green-Red-Red) candle pattern, calculates the Touch Trigger Level from candle bodies, monitors LTF for price touch, then fires POV.
_comment_pov: POV slicer. The 'action' and 'quantity' here are used only when no signal is enabled (manual mode). When a signal fires, it supplies the action/quantity.
_comment_strategies:
Toggle each strategy on/off. 'pov' is the slicer. 'keylevel' is manual price trigger. 'ocl_keylevel' is the OCL pattern-based signal (scans HTF for RRG/GRR pattern, monitors LTF for touch, fires POV).
  - { 'keylevel': false, 'pov': true }       -> manual mode (slicer fires immediately)
  - { 'keylevel': true,  'pov': true }       -> wait for manual keylevel, then POV
  - { 'ocl_keylevel': true, 'pov': true }    -> wait for OCL pattern, then POV
  - { 'pov': true }                          -> same as first; no signal enabled
_comment_symbol: Top-level symbol/exchange. Shared by every enabled strategy unless overridden in its own block.

ocl_keylevel._comment_exec_mode: exec_mode: ONE_SHOT (default) = fire once per run | CONTINUOUS = fire on every touch (cooldown enforced) | COUNT_LIMITED = fire up to max_fires times | AUTO = fire once per new pattern (re-arms on rearm_on_fire)
ocl_keylevel._comment_execution_settings: [EXECUTION SETTINGS] Per-Run Slicing Behavior (USER-DEFINED). Controls how many times the signal can fire and how much qty per fire.

pov._comment_depth_offset_ticks: Default 1 means LIMIT orders are placed at best_bid + 1 tick (BUY) or best_ask - 1 tick (SELL) — 'joining the inside of the spread'. Set to 0 to sit exactly on the bid/ask.
pov._comment_exchange_compliance: Feature 5-8: Exchange & Compliance Operations. Set these only for SME / PCAS / restricted scrips. For plain NSE equity they can stay at their defaults.
pov._comment_safety_guards: Depth-aware execution safety guards (OpenAlgo SDK-style). All three are enabled by default and degrade safely to the legacy ceiling_price / max_slice_quantity paths when client.depth(...) is unavailable. Knobs you will most often want to tweak: depth_offset_ticks, depth_slice_min_qty, circuit_buffer_pct.
pov._comment_system_stability: Feature 9-12: System Stability & State Preservation. Throttle helpers and the persistent ledger use the shared platform database.pov_db when available; otherwise the framework runs in-memory only with a warning.
pov._comment_vwap_band_slippage: Feature 13: VWAP Value Filter (Phase 1) + Slippage Feedback Loop (Phase 2). The POV rate now varies smoothly between min_pov_pct and max_pov_pct based on the position of LTP inside a dynamic VWAP band. When the rolling-mean slippage (in bps) crosses max_slippage_bps, the rate is multiplied by slippage_penalty_factor and clamped to min_pov_pct. Both features default to ENABLED but degrade safely when their inputs are missing. Set vwap_filter_enabled=false and/or slippage_guard_enabled=false to restore the legacy behaviour.
pov._example_quick_presets:
Common tuning recipes - copy/paste any one of these into the safety guards above.
  1) AGGRESSIVE (the new default - sit 1 tick inside the spread, never slice less than 50 shares, pause 1% from circuit):
       "depth_offset_ticks": 1, "depth_slice_min_qty": 50, "circuit_buffer_pct": 1.0
  2) PATIENT (sit exactly on bid/ask, skip dust orders, 0.3% circuit buffer):
       "depth_offset_ticks": 0, "depth_slice_min_qty": 10, "circuit_buffer_pct": 0.3
  3) DEEPER (sit 2 ticks inside the spread — for very illiquid names where the spread is wide):
       "depth_offset_ticks": 2, "depth_slice_min_qty": 25, "circuit_buffer_pct": 0.5
  4) LEGACY-COMPATIBLE (disable every guard, fall back to ceiling_price / max_slice_quantity):
       "depth_aware_pricing": false, "depth_slice_cap": false, "circuit_guard_enabled": false
